sources.use: Full page read: 38-42cm, yellow eye ring, dark grey bill/feet, pale brown head-neck, rufescent belly, scalloped mantle and rusty uppertail coverts. Native range, LC decreasing.
Fulvous whistling duck tawny plumage, grey bill/legs and white rump crescent.
Fulvous white rump and whitish flank plumes, versus chestnut-rumped Lesser.
Wandering lacks Lesser yellow eye ring; prominent black/white flank plumes. Comparisons are similar taxa, not claimed Hong Kong wild records.
Wandering Chinese name, dark nape line and range; not a local HK abundance claim.
